notes: Strip f: x 8030-10540 plus ~300 px overlap to x 7730. Reading Road runs diagonally along the plate's east edge; its centreline is ~110-120 px wide and was fixed from both edges (north of Hale it is nearly straight, x = 10454 - 0.382*(y-858)). Many stubs of streets east of Reading appear only as short cut-off pieces: Glenwood (GLE...), an M/N... stub at y~1838, Lexington (LEXI...), an unreadable stub at y~2780, Rockdale, a W... stub at y~3761, a CL... stub at y~4338 (likely Clinton Springs Avenue), a B... stub at y~4985 (taken as Blair Avenue) and an unnamed slanted stub at y~6540; their crossings are picked on Reading's centreline. Glenwood jogs ~120 px at Washington (two T's); Maple jogs ~210 px at Knott (two T's, the east one an L-corner where Knott ends). Van Antwerp Road: label read as VAN ANTWERP (lower) + ROAD (upper); its centre drifts from x~8312 at Glenwood to x~8270 at Forest and its east edge steps in ~30 px at y~1400. Stewart Place: name assumed from STEWART (west segment) + PL. (east segment). Lines inside streets labelled W.P./S.P. were ignored when measuring edges. Highland Avenue and the north-south leg of Carplin Place lie west of x 7730 (outside the overlap).
